has_mcv__iron_deficiency_anemia.subject: iron_deficiency_anemia
has_mcv__iron_deficiency_anemia.source: Iron-deficiency anemia is a microcytic anemia (low mean corpuscular volume).

classic_finding__iron_deficiency_anemia.subject: iron_deficiency_anemia
classic_finding__iron_deficiency_anemia.source: Iron-deficiency anemia can cause koilonychia (spoon-shaped nails).

classic_finding__thalassemia.subject: thalassemia
classic_finding__thalassemia.source: Thalassemia classically shows target cells on the peripheral blood smear.

has_mcv__sideroblastic_anemia.subject: sideroblastic_anemia
has_mcv__sideroblastic_anemia.source: Sideroblastic anemia is typically a microcytic anemia.

classic_finding__sideroblastic_anemia.subject: sideroblastic_anemia
classic_finding__sideroblastic_anemia.source: Sideroblastic anemia is defined by ringed sideroblasts in the bone marrow.

has_mcv__b12_deficiency_anemia.subject: b12_deficiency_anemia
has_mcv__b12_deficiency_anemia.source: Vitamin B12 deficiency causes a macrocytic (megaloblastic) anemia.

classic_finding__b12_deficiency_anemia.subject: b12_deficiency_anemia
classic_finding__b12_deficiency_anemia.source: Megaloblastic anemia (B12 or folate deficiency) shows hypersegmented neutrophils.

has_mcv__hereditary_spherocytosis.subject: hereditary_spherocytosis
has_mcv__hereditary_spherocytosis.source: Hereditary spherocytosis is a normocytic hemolytic anemia.

classic_finding__hereditary_spherocytosi.subject: hereditary_spherocytosis
classic_finding__hereditary_spherocytosi.source: Hereditary spherocytosis shows spherocytes on the peripheral smear.

has_mcv__g6pd_deficiency.subject: g6pd_deficiency
has_mcv__g6pd_deficiency.source: G6PD deficiency causes an episodic normocytic hemolytic anemia.

classic_finding__g6pd_deficiency.subject: g6pd_deficiency
classic_finding__g6pd_deficiency.source: G6PD deficiency shows bite cells and Heinz bodies on the peripheral smear.
